'''''Memories Past''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Memories Past'' featured in the online game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it could be obtained by players during the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] event in [[2005]].
